title: Steal and Collapse
mission: Collapse rooms without breaking the vault
concept: BST delete: leaf, one child, two children
briefing: Stealing a treasure collapses its room. A leaf room simply vanishes; a room with one corridor lets its child take over; a room with two corridors swaps its treasure with its inorder successor first. Name the case before each theft.
hints: Count the room's corridors going down: none = leaf, one = one child, two = two children.
The inorder successor is the smallest key in the right subtree - watch the value swap.
